title: Template: Offline Lead Triage for Inflammatory Kinase
goal: Build a reproducible medicinal-chemistry triage report from candidate SMILES, mixed-unit MAPK14 activity records, structural liabilities, and safety signals.

skillsmpReference.selectionReason: The higher-star clinical-decision skill is less computational-chemistry-specific; drug-discovery directly covers ChEMBL-style activity normalization, RDKit descriptors, lead-likeness, ADMET and safety triage.

designGoals: Keep with-skill and without-skill identical except for environment/skills and the corresponding runtime copy/removal logic.
Use a real research workflow rather than an app repair task: standardize structures, normalize activity, score drug-likeness, and produce an auditable lead triage report.
Verify behavior through outputs and dynamic data perturbation instead of binding to one exact implementation.
Make the task theoretically solvable without a skill while preserving a high diagnosis and convergence cost around censored potency, descriptor choice, safety flags, and series diversity.

dataSources: Synthetic frozen dataset modeled on ChEMBL activity records
Medicinal-chemistry target profile and assay notes
runtimeChain: local safety-normalizer service started by verifier
pytest verifier reading generated CSV, JSON and method notes

mainTests: Output files, schema, rank ordering, score range, and JSON summary contract.
RDKit canonical parent structures and descriptor values.
Safety exclusions, structural alerts, ranking, and series diversity.
guardrails: Dynamic verifier-added candidate must be parsed and scored from data.
Invalid structures, duplicate parents and hard safety risks must remain auditable.
Method notes must mention concrete chemistry and activity-normalization decisions.
